component.name: Hik Monitor
component.summary: View and record Hikvision NVR cameras

description.p: Hik Monitor is a desktop application for monitoring Hikvision NVR systems on Linux. It supports live view with multi-camera grid layouts, recording playback with timeline scrubbing, and works with Hikvision, Safire (Hikvision-OEM), generic ONVIF cameras, and manual RTSP streams.

ul.li: Live view with 1x1, 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, 1+3 and 1+7 grid layouts
Recording search and playback with timeline scrubbing and speed control
Multi-NVR support and drag-and-drop cameras into grid cells
GPU-accelerated playback via VAAPI when available
ONVIF discovery and manual RTSP — work without any vendor SDK

description.p: Live view and playback for native Hikvision devices use the proprietary Hikvision HCNetSDK, which is owned by Hikvision and is not bundled with this application. When you add a Hikvision or Safire NVR, the app offers to download and install the SDK on demand into its own data directory; ONVIF and RTSP cameras work without it.
